summary: The State and Local Cybersecurity Grant Program provides funding to address cybersecurity risks and cybersecurity threats to information systems owned or operated by state, local, and tribal governments.
program_name: State and Local Cybersecurity Grant Program
title: FY2025 SLCGP Cybersecurity Grant

summary: The FY2025 Urban Areas Security Initiative provides funding to address the unique planning, operations, equipment, training, and exercise needs of the Cook County Urban Area.
evaluation_criteria: Applications evaluated on: critical infrastructure protection (30%), interoperable communications (25%), CBRNE detection capabilities (20%), information sharing (15%), budget justification (10%)
allowable_costs: Equipment, Training, Exercises, Planning, Personnel, Management and Administration, Contractual Services
title: FY2025 UASI Cook County NOFO
eligibility_criteria: Cook County jurisdictions and designated urban area partners.

summary: The FY2025 SHSP provides funding to support state and local efforts to prevent terrorism and other catastrophic events and to prepare the Nation for the threats and hazards that pose the greatest risk.
evaluation_criteria: Applications will be evaluated based on: alignment with THIRA/SPR gaps (30%), project feasibility and impact (25%), budget reasonableness (20%), organizational capacity (15%), sustainability (10%)
allowable_costs: Equipment, Training, Exercises, Planning, Personnel, Management and Administration
title: FY2025 State Homeland Security Program (SHSP) NOFO
eligibility_criteria: All counties, municipalities, and tribal organizations within the state are eligible to apply.
